boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten URI-recognized campus traditions and ceremonial practices, from first-week welcome events to the objects and procession that mark Commencement.

cards.title: Start with RhodyFest
cards.subtitle: URI first-year welcome tradition
cards.notes: Join the incoming-student welcome, sample the listed activities, and use the student-organization conversations to identify groups to explore after classes begin.
cards.short_summary: A URI welcome event combining activities, student organizations, food, and evening trivia.
cards.evidence_claim: URI Student Involvement describes RhodyFest as a welcome for incoming first-year students with free food, activities, student organizations, and a Memorial Union trivia competition.
cards.access_notes: Check URI Student Involvement for the current program and event details.

cards.title: Bring family to Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: URI fall campus tradition
cards.notes: Coordinate a campus visit around the scheduled weekend, then choose from the published activities, football programming, reception, tours, and evening entertainment.
cards.short_summary: A fall URI weekend that brings students and families into the campus calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: URI identifies Family Weekend as a signature tradition with campus activities, a Rhody football game, post-game reception, tours, and Saturday entertainment.
cards.access_notes: Program elements and registration requirements may vary by year.

cards.title: Browse the organization fairs
cards.subtitle: URI semesterly involvement tradition
cards.notes: Walk the fair early in the semester, ask organizations about meetings and membership, and note the groups you want to follow up with through URI’s involvement tools.
cards.short_summary: Semesterly gatherings where URI student organizations introduce themselves to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: URI Student Involvement states that Student Organization Fairs take place each semester and connect students with campus student organizations.
cards.access_notes: Look for the semester’s fair information through Student Involvement or URInvolved.

cards.title: Catch Beats & Eats
cards.subtitle: URI monthly music-and-food-truck tradition
cards.notes: Check the monthly listing, listen for WRIU’s music, and arrive while supplies last if you plan to use the event’s food-truck voucher or collect its giveaway.
cards.short_summary: A monthly URI gathering pairing WRIU music with a featured food truck.
cards.evidence_claim: URI Student Involvement says Beats & Eats occurs every month, features music played by WRIU and a food truck, and offers a free voucher and giveaway while supplies last.
cards.access_notes: Voucher and giveaway availability are limited while supplies last.

cards.title: Follow Fall Fest week
cards.subtitle: URI early-December tradition
cards.notes: Use the week’s schedule to pick daytime and evening programs, then reserve or arrive according to the current event instructions for the featured performance.
cards.short_summary: A weeklong early-December series of URI programs culminating in a major featured act.
cards.evidence_claim: URI Student Involvement describes Fall Fest as an early-December weeklong series with daytime and evening programs, including a major concert featuring a comedian or musical performance.
cards.access_notes: Featured performers and individual-event requirements change by year.

cards.title: Celebrate at the Rainville Awards
cards.subtitle: URI annual leadership-recognition tradition
cards.notes: Review the annual recognition details, support nominated peers and teams, and attend only through the current event process if you are eligible or invited.
cards.short_summary: An annual URI awards event recognizing student leaders, employees, and organizational teams.
cards.evidence_claim: URI Student Involvement calls the Rainville Awards an annual event recognizing URI student leaders, employees, and organizational teams, with dinner, awards, and a slideshow.
cards.access_notes: Attendance, nomination, and invitation details should be confirmed for the current year.

cards.title: Begin with International Welcome Week
cards.subtitle: URI incoming-international-student tradition
cards.notes: Use orientation to learn campus resources and community expectations, then attend the sessions that fit your arrival plan as an international or exchange student.
cards.short_summary: URI’s welcome and orientation programming for incoming international and exchange students.
cards.evidence_claim: URI lists International Welcome Week & Orientation among its signature traditions and says it serves incoming international students and exchanges as they begin study.
cards.access_notes: Intended for incoming international students and exchange students; confirm current orientation instructions.

cards.title: Make a plan for O-Week
cards.subtitle: URI move-in week tradition
cards.notes: RSVP through the current URI listing, keep your QR code ready, and select repeated events that help you settle in, meet people, and explore campus.
cards.short_summary: A move-in-week series that introduces new URI students to campus life before classes.
cards.evidence_claim: URI lists Orientation Week (O-Week) as a signature tradition: a weeklong series beginning during move-in, with free repeated events for new students before classes.
cards.access_notes: URI advises participants to RSVP early and bring the required QR code; schedules vary annually.

cards.title: Spot the University Mace
cards.subtitle: URI Commencement ceremonial object
cards.notes: During Commencement, watch for the Grand Marshal carrying the mace after the color guard; view it as part of the formal procession rather than handling it.
cards.short_summary: A gold-plated ceremonial mace donated by URI’s graduating Class of 1963.
cards.evidence_claim: URI says the University Mace, donated by the Class of 1963, follows the color guard in Commencement’s academic procession and bears the URI seal and Davis Hall sketch.
cards.access_notes: Seen as part of URI’s formal Commencement ceremony.

cards.title: Watch the color guard lead the procession
cards.subtitle: URI Commencement ceremonial practice
cards.notes: Arrive in time for the opening procession and watch the URI color guard present the colors before the Grand Marshal, faculty, and degree candidates follow.
cards.short_summary: The ceremonial opening of URI’s academic procession at Commencement.
cards.evidence_claim: URI states that its color guard presents the colors and leads the academic procession, followed by the Grand Marshal with the University Mace, faculty, and degree candidates.
cards.access_notes: Follow current Commencement visitor guidance and seating instructions.
